findings.finding: Writer refined the title to Poser des limites n’est pas s’éloigner so that 疏远 means distancing rather than neutral spatial distance.
Replaced a potentially distracting passive participle with tout ce qui n’est pas dit while preserving the privacy/concealment distinction.
Clarified the metaphor of acquiring another person's direction as acquiring the right to decide that direction.

Deck says a no can genuinely end persuasion; paragraph12 says not every no must immediately end discussion. Both source claims are faithfully retained, including paragraph14's distinction between communication and wearing someone down.
